assessment.rationale: A man stands on dry pavement looking at flooded street with water reaching up to his ankles. The water is at the man's ankles.

The picture shows a flooded river with water reaching around a stone pillar and partially submerging a bridge structure. Water is at the base of the pillar and around the bridge supports, with no visible people or vehicles.

The image shows an aerial view of flooded buildings surrounded by palm trees, with water reaching up to the first floor windows and doors of the structures. Water is at the level of the ground-floor window sills and doors of the buildings.

Aerial view showing flooded residential area with houses, roads, and water covering fields and streets. Water reaches the rooftops of some houses and is at the level of car roofs and windows in others.
